storyInfo: Eloysius seeks out Hellagur. Evgeny Andrianov Kuznetsov, Marshal of the Fourth Army, coerces Scioppa Razin, commander of the Special Tactics Formation, into a suicide mission by claiming to have taken his second-in-command Sirka hostage. Meanwhile, Sirka infiltrates Zelgrad as an Infected.

attributes.content: Gospodin—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Gospodin Hellagur!
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Hm?
attributes.name: Hellagur
Eloysius
attributes.content: *pant* *pant*

attributes.name: Eloysius
attributes.content: Phew.
You were walking so fast. I caught a glimpse of your sheath back at the last corner, but you were already on the next block by the time I reached it.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The Imperial Guard's physical training is far more rigorous.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: ...I'm out of practice.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Did you need something?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Well, I had been looking forward to a chance to talk to you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: My work is done after seeing your colleagues off. What about you? Where are you headed?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Going back to the Oripathy treatment center before nightfall.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You do not need to be so concerned. It's unlikely that anyone would make an attempt on them in broad daylight.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Just an old man with too much time on his hands offering what help he can.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: There are many children there. It seems my colleagues believe that I am... good with children.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: I understand that you have the time to walk with me, then.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You wrote this, didn't you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The young woman takes out a battered book before Hellagur can react.
A breeze blows open the book cover, or what is left of it.
Eloysius presses the book cover harder, as though trying to keep it together, or perhaps it is simply a sign of nerves.
The old man sees the title of the book—
The Endless March.
I didn't think there were any left in Ursus—
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: (Whisper) ...I thought every copy was destroyed in the purge.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You didn't answer me directly, although your reaction alone validates my hypothesis, to an extent—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I didn't write it.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: But your name is in it, yes? You were once a glorious soldier, one whose name warranted mention in the military histories of Ursus. But now—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Whatever discovery you think you've made, your time and energy are better spent elsewhere.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: As I told your father, I'm not expecting the government to restore my name or status. For my part, I no longer serve the empire.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Grypherburg abides my presence only because it has no interest in a powerless ghost.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Whoever you're looking for, he's not here.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: The gauntlet leaves even more marks on the book cover, before she realizes and stops the act of destruction.
Eloysius puts away the book and ponders her next words.
Then...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What if I just wanted to walk with you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If you're not in a hurry to get to your babysitting assignment, there is a little show I would like you to see.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It will not take up too much of your time.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.text: I see you, Scioppa. Come, over here—
Look at you, getting yourself all wet again. What did you find?
No rush showing off your loot, little hero. Give me your hand and I'll show you how to wash it. Make sure you get all the mud and dirt out of your fingernails...
This way, father won't find out where you went and what you did.
I know you wouldn't stay here forever, but parting comes sooner than I thought. It seems like only yesterday you were hardly taller than that sword you're leaving with.
I don't intend to stop you, my little foal. I just want you to be careful...
Be wary of the future of the Volniki that those people paint, and their words about the glory of Ursus—those things don't necessarily belong to us.

attributes.content: This will do.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: You're already taking a huge risk by coming this far with me.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: Go back. Don't make your contact wait.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.text: What about you? Where will you go?

attributes.content: I got two good arms and two good legs, I'll go wherever I want to go. I'm a true Volnitsa now...
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: ...Hah.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: Maybe I'll leave Ursus and become a competition knight in Kazimierz.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: If they still take Infected knights.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.text: You should be on the battlefield, with me, with us—

attributes.content: Don't be silly, Scioppa.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: I'm Infected. This truth is firmer than any armor.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: But if you want to reminisce about the past, let's end it this way. Give me your back for the last time, then go back.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: Go back to your ship, to your brothers and sisters who are still healthy.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: We will not meet again, not until we hear the call of Baba—of death herself.
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: —Wake—
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: He's awake!
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: Bring him to me.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.text: Aurora, warship—and the hands grabbing me. It's like how Oleg kneads his dough; he always uses too much force.

attributes.content: What the hell does this kozyol grow up eating? He's heavier than a grown burdenbeast!
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Get him up, the Marshal wants to see him—
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Blyat!
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.text: Where were my limbs when I fainted? I could hardly feel them now, much less stand. Damn...
At least now I know that the deck of the Fourth Army's flagship doesn't feel any different from the floor of a temporary barracks when you're lying on it.

attributes.content: He seems barely conscious. Did you forget I told you to take it easy with the torture?
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: We didn't forget, sir. All we did was waterboard him, per your instructions, in order to get him to confess to his crimes.
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Did he?
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: No, sir...
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Then I suppose I'll have to do it myself.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Pick him up.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: It is unbecoming of a major to lie on the floor like this.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Wait, he's twitching—he's trying to get away! Pin him down!
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Keep him pinned! Don't let go!
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Argh, he's strong. Good thing we confiscated all his toys.
attributes.name: Army Soldier

attributes.content: Good, don't move, stay right there... very good.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Look up, Scioppa Razin.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Your High Excellency... Marshal Evgeny...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: When did I offend you, sir?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You did not offend me, Major Razin. I am simply deeply disappointed in your lies and disloyalty.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: But your betrayal must be dealt with, in order to give an explanation to all the loyal soldiers of the Fourth Army, who are still fighting on the front lines.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Now tell me, is it true that you and 'Sechin' have been repeatedly assisting the Infected in escaping the camp?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I never helped the Infected—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: No, you didn't. You were helping your comrades who had unfortunately contracted Oripathy, weren't you?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You have no evidence.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You were careful, but even the best-laid plans have flaws. You have never tried to help an Infected soldier escape during wartime, have you?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You were too hasty. You forgot that non-Ursus soldiers stand out in camp, and how many eyes are watching you.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I know. That's why it makes perfect sense to become a deserter at a time like this.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Which is why I see no reason for you to slander them as Infected.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: If you wish to capture them and put them on trial—*cough* *cough*—I would certainly do all I can to assist. It was the result of my negligence, after all.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But if you want to frame me for crimes I didn't commit...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: No amount of rumor and hearsay makes evidence that would be admissible to a court martial.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: All you can do is torture me until you get the answer you want to hear straight from my mouth.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: And that's not happening.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Is that so...?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Then perhaps this one will be more persuasive.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Scioppa...?
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: *cough* *cough*!
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: Impossible.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Impossible! I sent her away, I saw with my own eyes—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Scioppa. I...
attributes.name: Cold Voice

attributes.content: That will do. Cut the line.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: She tried to commit suicide as soon as she was captured. It took a great deal of effort to resuscitate her.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: But you let her down, didn't you?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Let go of him. He has confessed.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Now, we can talk about the price of betrayal.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Give him a jacket.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: It will not do to have someone freeze to death on my ship.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Well then, thank you for your kindness...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Your High Excellency.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Enough posturing. I know what you want to say.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: My men wouldn't have caught your second-in-command, if she hadn't been so loyal that she remained near the base even after she was escorted away from the front lines.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You did a clean job. But it wasn't good enough.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Did she really try to kill herself—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Oh, you want to hear more? She put a dagger through her chest. Still struggles to string together a sentence.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Apparently, it wasn't the Army's standard-issue, but custom-made for your people.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: He opens his palm, and a soldier places a silver dagger upon it.
Evgeny takes a brief look at it before letting go, allowing it to hit the floor.
Scioppa's gaze is fixed upon the silver dagger on the ground.
Even in the dim light, he can distinguish the red enchantment etchings on the sheath, and the name of the owner, a little faded from age.
You—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You recognize it?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: ...What do you want?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Do you remember the 'bomb' that fell near the front lines of the Third and Seventh Armies?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Sechin will retrieve this for me.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: The bomb's gone boom. Everyone knows that. Do you want me to bring you the shrapnel?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: People like you, living on the edge of death, often fail to see imminent danger, much less the full picture of the war.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I forgive you this.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Listen. The enemy of Ursus has always been the blind and stubborn State Council, not the Second Army that is simply following orders to fight me.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I have wasted too much time on rebellions, internal conflict, infiltration, and corruption. I must bring things back on track.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: As the first step, the Volnov, Sechin's flagship, will sail to the First Army's satellite city where they are developing the weapon, and take it.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Are you out of your mind?!
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The Second Army's Vanguard Battalion alone could easily destroy the Volnov, and that's before talking about the automated defenses that will be triggered should we somehow manage to cross into the Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Why do you think I'm not prepared to 'repay' their contempt? What the State Council did in December, I will pay back tenfold, a hundredfold.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You bought the Second Army off?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Watch your words. Besides, this is not your concern.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Fine. Let's say you're 'prepared', and the Second Army won't try to stop us. What happens once we reach the satellite city? We know nothing about that thing.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: All you need to do is carry out my orders. You will receive further instructions when the time comes.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: That's just empty words. I need a concrete plan. I have my men to think about.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: My patience is limited, Major Razin.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I am not negotiating with you. I am stating my demands, which you will accept.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You and your formation will carry out my will, even if it's a suicide mission.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: The alternative is for your second-in-command and the other Infected that you sent away to, let's say, 'seek the easy way out'.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I already know where most of them are.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: What is Sechin to you—
attributes.name: Scioppa
Evgeny
attributes.content: Understand, Major Razin, that I have tried to deal with your unit more civilly.

attributes.name: Evgeny
attributes.content: Unfortunately, it has not worked.
Perhaps you have forgotten what you promised me when the Fourth Army accepted your ragtag band of outlanders.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You swore absolute loyalty to me and the Fourth Army, in exchange for the independent status of the Special Tactics Formation Sechin.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: There was to be no more wavering between Armies, no more insolence and defiance. You were to be obedient as a burdenbeast, fierce as a tuskbeast.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Which part of the promise have you kept?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Oh, you want to dig up old scores like a divorce hearing? Two can play that game.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Shall we talk about all the help we provided behind the scenes? The mutiny in December that Sechin suppressed, not to mention all the other similar dirty work...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Including the decapitation operations that no one else wants to do.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Are you saying none of them count now, Your High Excellency?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Your sarcasm falls flat.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You have committed enough dereliction of duty during the campaign to be hanged ten times along with your entire unit.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: In the most recent case, the operation in the Far North should have been perfect; there should have been no survivors, but for your cowardice.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: But you were unresponsive and failed to clean up in time, allowing the pests to run free. And still I tolerated your negligence.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You briefly proved you were still useful in the mutiny. The members of your unit who gave their lives died for a worthy cause, I'm sure you accepted that gladly.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You're on your third chance now, Major Razin.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I suggest you take it.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: <p=1>Forest in Zelgrad Transfer Area</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Find your spot and line up. Do not try to get into the city through the forest!
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: If you're caught, you will lose your place and be sent to the eastern mines!
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Next.
attributes.name: Announcer

attributes.content: Me! It's me—my turn!
attributes.name: Timid Miner

attributes.content: Finally...
attributes.name: Timid Miner

attributes.content: Next, get in line.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Infected, miners... aren't we the kind of technical talent that Zelgrad really needs?
attributes.name: Scared Scholar

attributes.content: I'd rather keep my distance from them, even though I'm Infected now too... good thing we're not in the same queue.
attributes.name: Scared Scholar

attributes.content: Stay strong! We'll find our path once we're inside.
attributes.name: Proud Scholar

attributes.content: 'Zelgrad, the Tulskaya of the new era, Ursus's largest industrial base in the future.' That's what the slogans on the barrenlands trucks all say!
attributes.name: Proud Scholar

attributes.content: Zelgrad will make every precision chip in the empire, as Tulskaya once made every shell!
attributes.name: Proud Scholar

attributes.content: If we're part of the project, that means we're needed, even as Infected—
attributes.name: Proud Scholar

attributes.content: It means Marshal Buterina understands the value of our minds.
attributes.name: Proud Scholar

attributes.content: Nearly everyone is Infected.
Why are you standing in our line? You... you almost look like a noble.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: Only almost.
Huh?
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: Are you waiting to enter Zelgrad?
Yeah, did you see that miner who just went inside? He said he was from western mines. I guess the mines there have been shut down too, like the ones in the north.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: But there's another checkpoint up ahead. Whether they can actually get in is probably a matter of luck.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: Zelgrad never used to accept the Infected, despite the Tsar's orders.
I was wondering too, but I have a relative in the city who said the factories were hiring, and that maybe there'll be work for me.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: My only skill was fixing Originium stoves, but I thought I would check things out anyway. Didn't expect to see all the Infected here.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: Or maybe it was because of that thing.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: The worker looks around warily before continuing.
(Whisper) I heard that all the Originium is gone from the mines.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: As far as I know, the mines in the southeast still have reserves.
Well, I don't know about that... everywhere is a mess these days, but we can't have unemployed Infected running around the place. Someone has to take them in.
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: What about you? Why are you here? You're not Infected, are you?
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: ...No, I am.
If it bothers you, I could leave and join another queue.
Oh. Well, I don't think you should be here in the first place—
attributes.name: Perplexed Worker

attributes.content: Mercenary?
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Veteran.
Unit number?
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Special unit?
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: By His Imperial Majesty's decree, there's no such thing as 'special'.
...But you're Kuranta, not Ursus.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Forget it. Come with me.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Why did you bring me here?
There's a special passage for nobles.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: But you don't know who I am.
Veteran, lieutenant, duke, count, heir, bastard, they're all the same to me.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: You're an Infected who wants to enter Zelgrad, so you'll wait here.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Someone will come and meet you once your identity is verified.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Who's talking—
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Goodness, Grisha, you can't treat a noble like this!
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You can deal with her then, if you know so much about dealing with nobles.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Erm, excuse me...
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Sirka.
Gospozha Sirka!
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Ah, well, as Grisha said, you'll have to wait here.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: So Zelgrad is really opening its doors to the Infected.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: You have never heeded the Tsar's orders before. Why do so now?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Well, I'm not sure... but I bet it has something to do with the Generalik.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: The 'General' of the First Army with nary a feat to his name.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: So you know—
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: He has quite a reputation.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Well, we shouldn't be talking about him like this.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Nobody's listening.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: How do you know?
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: My Arts. You could yell 'I'm gonna kill that marshal's idiot son' at the top of your lungs right now—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Shh—!
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: ...And nobody would hear you.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Sirka cooperates by remaining quiet for a moment. There is no sound coming from outside the tent, not even the soldiers who should be stationed nearby.
(Shakes head)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Maybe they just haven't reacted yet.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You don't have to talk if you don't want to. But you can think of it as turning on the kitchen radio when you go home, chatting to the potted plant on the windowsill over a cup of water.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ...What do you want to hear about?
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Anything you're willing to talk about.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Hmm.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You could start with this Generalik.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Alright, I'll tell you about my theory.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: I think Zelgrad is opening its doors to the Infected because of the Generalik.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Reason?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: (Whisper) Because the Generalik got infected.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Thank you for your candor.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Maybe I just wanted someone who's not intimidated by him to know.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: My brother was one of the Generalik's bodyguards. After the assassination attempt that got the Generalik infected, he and his fellow teammates were executed. Their arms and legs were severed, and they were left to bleed to death.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: The person who brought the compensation said he was killed in action by a Kazimierzian mine, that they never found his body.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: I wish we didn't.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You found it.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Our mother is a medic. Cleaning up bodies is her job.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You can imagine the rest.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: ...My condolences.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Life goes on.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: May I ask where the assassination attempt occurred?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: On the main street of Zelgrad in broad daylight. The assassin was killed on the spot.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Yet he came back.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Yeah, that was a surprise...
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: A heavy topic to discuss.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: You're not the one who should apologize. Let me tell you something a little more light-hearted in exchange.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Do you know that the queues outside are a mix of Infected and non-Infected?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I would have thought that the Infected would be segregated into their own queue.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Bozhe moy! I-I must check!
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: Please wait here for Grisha, Gospozha Sirka—
attributes.name: Surprised Soldier

attributes.content: I'm sorry.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Your identity has been confirmed, but I'm afraid you're not getting away.
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: Your name is on file as a deserter. We must hand you over to the Fourth Army—
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier

attributes.content: ...Gospozha?
attributes.name: Aloof Soldier
